output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply parameter is provided by the user, allowing it to be set to a very large value, resulting in an overflow of the totalSupply variable and allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the balance of any user.

The transfer function has a wrong logic where it does not check if the contract is frozen, allowing users to transfer tokens to a contract address, where the contract can be frozen, making the funds inaccessible.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The price variable is decreased in the buy function, allowing it to overflow and become very large, causing a denial of service attack.
